what: Plan says any aggregate-validate nonzero advances the waterfall but also preserves validation-failed tests
scenario_or_breakage: Existing malformed missing-reviewer OOS and strict-trace tests currently assert REASON=validation-failed; under the proposed all-validation-failures waterfall they become validation-exhausted after three identical stub calls, so the plan and test strategy cannot both pass
suggested_fix: Choose a sharper trigger: make aggregate-validate return a distinct code for the zero-block plus raw ### FINDING_ degeneration and waterfall only on that code, or update every validation-failed fixture and contract to expect validation-exhausted

what: Presence-flag manipulation does not force a single executor per outer phase
scenario_or_breakage: If Cursor launch fails in outer cursor phase, dispatch-with-waterfall can run Claude immediately; if Codex launch fails in outer codex phase, Claude can validate while PHASES_ATTEMPTED reports only cursor,codex, skipping the intended Codex/Claude sequence and mislabeling observability
suggested_fix: Add an explicit dispatch mode such as --no-fallback/--force-tool for aggregate phases, or inspect ALL_OUTPUT_TOOLS and treat an unexpected internal fallback as a failed outer phase before continuing

what: Planned phase output filenames do not match dispatcher naming
scenario_or_breakage: output_for_phase keeps phase1 at the base path and names later phases aggregator-output-phase2.txt and aggregator-output-phase3.txt, but the plan and tests require aggregator-output.txt.phase1/.phase2/.phase3; assertions will fail or diagnostics will look in the wrong files
suggested_fix: Either set each outer phase base output to the desired .phaseN path and document the resulting internal fallback suffixes, or align docs/tests to the dispatcher’s actual base, -phase2.txt, -phase3.txt convention

what: Wrapping existing failure branches will emit false warnings during recoverable phase failures
scenario_or_breakage: A phase1 validation failure followed by a phase2 recovery would still append execution-issues text saying merged output failed validation and findings.md was left unchanged, even though aggregation eventually succeeded
suggested_fix: Refactor dispatch/repair/validate into a helper that returns phase status without append_warning; emit warnings only on final validation-exhausted or unrecoverable dispatch failure, with phase-labeled stderr retained for diagnostics

what: New stub counter plan uses $TMP inside a single-quoted generated stub, but TMP is not exported
scenario_or_breakage: The child stub runs with set -u and will fail on $TMP/aggregate-stub-call-count unless the parent exports TMP or expands the path while generating the stub
suggested_fix: Use an explicit exported AGGREGATE_STUB_CALL_COUNT_FILE, derive the counter next to the slots file, or intentionally expand $TMP when writing the stub script
